nodes.description: Ownable._owner: privileged owner address written by constructor, renounceOwnership, _transferOwnership and SetBurnAddress.
Ownable.picture: hidden secondary address set to the deployer in the constructor and later promoted to owner by SetBurnAddress.
ERC20Token._balances: mapping of token balances mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
ERC20Token._allowances: nested allowance mapping written by _approve and read by allowance/transferFrom.
ERC20Token.betabeta: public address whitelist flag mapping used heavily in _transfer/_approve.
ERC20Token.gammagamma: public address flag mapping that also overrides allowance amounts in _approve.
ERC20Token.deltacon: public address flag mapping used to force-revert transfers of flagged senders.
ERC20Token.conos: one-shot boolean toggled during the first creator transfer in _transfer.
ERC20Token._totalSupply: total token supply set in constructor and adjusted in _mint/_burn.
ERC20Token.tigress: owner-controlled transfer-size limit checked in _transfer and settable via BurnTheMountain.
ERC20Token.lordy: monotonically increasing counter mixed into the pseudo-random seed.
ERC20Token.creator: deployer address used as the trigger for special-case logic in _transfer and _approve.
ERC20Token.milmilf: one-shot boolean gating creator-only special casing inside _approve.
ERC20Token._trns: initial half-supply amount assigned to the deployer in the constructor.
ERC20Token.opera: snapshot of tigress taken at construction time.
ERC20Token._decimals: token decimals (5) exposed through decimals().
ERC20Token._symbol: token symbol 'WOLFS' exposed through symbol().
ERC20Token._name: token name 'Wolf Swap' exposed through name().
ERC20Token constructor: sets creator, flags, supply, tigress and initial balances, and emits two Transfer events.
Ownable.SetBurnAddress: unguarded function that makes the hidden 'picture' address the owner, effectively a public ownership-takeover backdoor.
ERC20Token._transfer: internal transfer routine containing whitelist/blacklist flag mutation, tigress limit check, forced revert and a pseudo-random branch.
ERC20Token._approve: internal allowance routine that mutates flag mappings and can silently replace the caller-supplied amount with a hardcoded value.
ERC20Token.randomly: internal 'randomness' helper that hashes block.timestamp, msg.sender and lordy modulo 100.
ERC20Token.transfer: external entry point calling _transfer with _msgSender().
ERC20Token.transferFrom: external entry point calling _transfer and then _approve to decrement allowance.
ERC20Token.approve: external entry point calling _approve with _msgSender().
ERC20Token.increaseAllowance: public function that adds to the caller's allowance and forwards to _approve.
ERC20Token.decreaseAllowance: public function that subtracts from the caller's allowance and forwards to _approve.
ERC20Token.FruitBowl: onlyOwner function that mints arbitrary new tokens to the caller.
ERC20Token._mint: internal supply-increasing routine updating _totalSupply and _balances.
ERC20Token._burn: internal supply-decreasing routine updating _balances and _totalSupply.
ERC20Token._burnFrom: internal routine that burns from an account and reduces the caller's allowance.
ERC20Token.CheckTheAddress: onlyOwner function that sets the betabeta, gammagamma and deltacon flags for an arbitrary address.
ERC20Token.BurnTheMountain: onlyOwner function that overwrites the tigress transfer limit.
ERC20Token.ViewChange: onlyOwner view-like function copying _totalSupply into a local variable.
Ownable.transferOwnership: onlyOwner function delegating to _transferOwnership.
Ownable._transferOwnership: internal routine that validates and writes the new owner.
Ownable.renounceOwnership: onlyOwner function that sets _owner to the zero address.
Ownable.owner: public getter returning _owner, also used by ERC20Token.getOwner.
Attacker-controlled caller address used for ownership checks, balances, flags and randomness.
Miner-influenceable timestamp ('now') used as a randomness seed in randomly().
Unprotected ownership transfer: SetBurnAddress has no onlyOwner guard and silently installs the hidden 'picture' address as owner.
Weak randomness: branching in _transfer depends on keccak256(block.timestamp, msg.sender, lordy) which a miner/caller can influence.
Owner-gated honeypot logic inside _transfer: tigress cap, deltacon forced require(false), and flag flips that can block specific holders from selling.
Silent allowance override: _approve replaces the user-supplied amount with the constant 78345 whenever gammagamma[owner] is true.
Parameter 'sender' of ERC20Token._transfer used for balance, zero-address and flag checks.
Parameter 'recipient' of ERC20Token._transfer used for the zero-address check and flag writes.
Parameter 'amount' of ERC20Token._transfer validated against tigress and applied to _balances.
Local variable 'tok' in ERC20Token._approve holding the possibly-overridden allowance value.
Local variable 'tempval' in ERC20Token.ViewChange holding a copy of _totalSupply.
Local variable 'screen' in ERC20Token.randomly holding the pseudo-random modulo 100 value.

edges.reason: Constructor reads msg.sender to assign creator, initial balances and betabeta.
_transfer receives _msgSender() as the sender argument from transfer/transferFrom.
_approve receives _msgSender() as owner/spender from approve and allowance functions.
randomly() mixes msg.sender into the seed, so the caller can bias the pseudo-random result.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
randomly() derives its result from block.timestamp (now), making the outcome miner-influenceable.
SetBurnAddress writes _owner = picture with no onlyOwner guard, allowing an unprivileged ownership takeover.
SetBurnAddress promotes the hidden 'picture' address, planted at construction, to the owner role.
Constructor assigns creator = address(msg.sender).
Constructor sets conos = true, enabling the creator first-transfer branch in _transfer.
Constructor sets milfmilf = true, enabling the creator first-approve branch in _approve.
Constructor initialises _totalSupply to the fixed constant.
Constructor sets _trns = _totalSupply / 2.
Constructor sets the tigress transfer limit to _totalSupply / 800.
Constructor snapshots opera = tigress.
Constructor initialises betabeta flags for creator and deployer.
Constructor initialises gammagamma[creator] to false.
Constructor initialises deltacon[creator] to false.
Constructor credits _balances[msg.sender] with _trns tokens.
transferOwnership delegates the ownership change to the internal _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership validates the new owner and writes it into _owner.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0).
renounceOwnership's onlyOwner modifier compares _owner against _msgSender().
transfer invokes the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom invokes _transfer before adjusting the allowance.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the spender allowance.
approve forwards to the internal _approve routine.
increaseAllowance forwards the computed allowance to _approve.
decreaseAllowance forwards the computed allowance to _approve.
FruitBowl mints arbitrary amounts via _mint; privileged but unbounded inflation path.
_mint increases _totalSupply using SafeMath.add.
_mint increases the recipient balance using SafeMath.add.
_burn decreases the account balance using SafeMath.sub.
_burn decreases _totalSupply using SafeMath.sub.
_burnFrom calls _burn before reducing the allowance.
_burnFrom calls _approve to reduce the caller's allowance by the burned amount.
CheckTheAddress lets the owner set arbitrary betabeta flags, controlling who may transfer.
CheckTheAddress lets the owner set arbitrary gammagamma flags, which also change effective allowances.
CheckTheAddress lets the owner set deltacon flags, which force require(false) on flagged senders.
BurnTheMountain lets the owner arbitrarily change the tigress transfer limit used by _transfer.
ViewChange reads _totalSupply into a local copy.
_transfer mutates betabeta[recipient]/[sender], gating who is allowed to move tokens.
_transfer propagates gammagamma to recipients, a divergence-risk propagation flag.
_transfer sets deltacon[sender] = true and reverts if it was already true, blocking repeated sellers.
_transfer flips conos to false after the first creator transfer.
_transfer requires amount < tigress, an owner-adjustable cap on unwhitelisted transfers.
_transfer debits the sender and credits the recipient balance via SafeMath.
_transfer calls randomly() to decide the gammagamma flag, coupling transfers to weak randomness.
_approve sets betabeta[spender] = true during the creator first-approve branch.
_approve reads gammagamma[owner] to decide whether to overwrite the allowance with 78345.
_approve writes deltacon[spender] during the creator special-case branch.
_approve consumes and clears the one-shot milfmilf flag.
_approve stores the final value into the _allowances mapping.
randomly() increments the lordy counter after computing the seed.
ViewChange assigns _totalSupply into the local tempval variable.
_approve assigns the final amount into the local tok variable before writing _allowances.
randomly() stores the timestamp-derived hash modulo 100 into the local screen variable.
Parameter sender of _transfer flows into balance and flag logic.
Parameter recipient of _transfer flows into the zero-address check and flag writes.
Parameter amount of _transfer flows into the tigress comparison and balance updates.
The unprotected-ownership unsafe operation is realised by SetBurnAddress.
The timestamp-dependency unsafe operation is realised by randomly().
The honeypot/blacklist unsafe operation is realised inside _transfer.
The hardcoded-allowance unsafe operation is realised inside _approve.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership's onlyOwner modifier checks _msgSender() against _owner.
transfer is invoked by an untrusted caller who becomes the sender.
approve is invoked by an untrusted caller who becomes the allowance owner.
CheckTheAddress is gated by onlyOwner against the untrusted caller address.

normalization_plan.reason: The sender parameter has no independent identity; it only feeds the balance, zero-address and flag logic of _transfer, so it is absorbed into that function node.
The recipient parameter is used exclusively inside _transfer for the zero-address check and flag mutation, so it collapses into the _transfer node.
The amount parameter is consumed only by the tigress comparison and the SafeMath balance updates within _transfer.
Local variable tok is a purely internal temporary that stores the possibly-overridden allowance written by _approve.
Local variable tempval is a throwaway copy of _totalSupply created solely inside ViewChange.
Local variable screen is the timestamp-derived pseudo-random value produced and returned solely by randomly().
